title: [3.0-beta1] No BG delta on Beta1
symptom: BG changes (delta) at the top of the screen are reporting as '0' despite BG obviously changing. This happens every time the app is brought up (not fresh start), and after about 5 minutes the delta will show.
cause: The problem is doubled BGs due to having both the Dexcom bridge in NS and the patched Dexcom app sending BG data.
fix: Disable Dexcom bridge in NS and use only the patched app.
evidence_quote: your problem is doubled BGs. Disable Dexcom bridge in NS and use only patched app
